paper_role: persistent device-loop architecture gate after straight-line XLA optimization barrier failed

frozen_configuration.schedule: FLUX.1-dev 50-step dynamically shifted FlowMatch Euler sigmas
frozen_configuration.segment_control_packet: fixed [9,2] FP32 coefficients plus [9,1] FP32 delta sigmas; zero-delta padding for shorter segments
frozen_configuration.reference_contract: round each prediction to BF16 before FP32 Euler, then round the updated latent to BF16 before the next loop iteration

memory_contract_addendum.source: hardware execution constraint supplied after the frozen H1g gate
memory_contract_addendum.scratchpad: SBUF is SRAM and is cleared at every diffusion step; it cannot hold anchors or latent persistently across steps.
memory_contract_addendum.candidate_loop_benefit_if_supported: Host/runtime dispatch amortization and an executable BF16 iteration boundary only.
benefit_explicitly_not_claimed: elimination of per-iteration HBM reads and writes
memory_contract_addendum.paper_implication: Use HBM-resident request state and dispatch-batched loop, not on-chip persistent state, as the precise architectural terminology.

development_attempts.diagnosis: scan's AOTAutograd FakeTensor trace interacted with Neuron custom-op-name dispatch and raised Expected XLA tensor, Got XLAFloatType before HLO generation

development_attempts.attempt: PyTorch while_loop HigherOrderOperator with registered XLA implementation
development_attempts.diagnosis: Neuron ModelBuilder's default INFO-level HLO metadata TorchDispatchMode had no HigherOrderOperator rule

development_attempts.attempt: HLO metadata disabled plus direct XLA While lowering with every control scalar included in carry
development_attempts.diagnosis: the lowered While body still captured two additional FP32 device-data parameters, so condition, body, body-result, and init tuple signatures differed

G0_host_reference.evidence: The nine-iteration CPU model, including zero-delta padding, is bit-exact to explicit per-step BF16 predictor and scheduler updates; the resident cache-step unit suite passed 4/4.

G1_compile_while.stage_reached: XLA While construction inside Neuron ModelBuilder trace
G1_compile_while.final_error_summary: While condition/body/init signatures are unequal because body lowering captures two extra FP32 device-data parameters.

G4_dispatch_contract.reason: The 20-entry cache schedule is an architecture projection, not an executed trace.

G5_scalar_boundary.reason: No runtime execution boundary exists without a compiled segment entry point.

analysis.what_failed: The current Torch/XLA plus Neuron ModelBuilder frontend could not express the candidate XLA While with resident module parameters and request-provided control packets as a closed, shape-stable loop signature.
analysis.what_did_not_fail: No Trainium numerical mismatch, latency regression, HBM overflow, or neuronx-cc backend rejection was observed because execution and backend compilation were never reached.
analysis.system_significance: The proposed loop would address H1e's host/runtime dispatch explosion at the correct granularity, but support for an XLA While primitive in the generic runtime is insufficient; the complete tracing, metadata, captured-input, alias-state, and compiler pipeline must share an executable loop contract. Even if supported, the loop carry can persist only in HBM because SBUF is cleared every diffusion step.
analysis.claim_limit: This result rejects the tested software stack and expression path, not all possible persistent loops, NKI implementations, future runtime versions, or custom backend integrations.

decision.next: Stop private frontend workarounds. Continue with orthogonal system characterization: H2 TP-aware placement and H3 scalar control-plane invariance. Reopen persistent loops only with a supported executable BF16 loop-carry contract.
